sanskrit_verse:
आम्नाये स्मृतितन्त्रे च लोकाचारे च सूरिभिः ।
शरीरार्धं स्मृता भार्या पुण्यापुण्यफले समा ॥
transliteration: āmnāye smṛtitantre ca lokācāre ca sūribhiḥ | śarīrārdhaṃ smṛtā bhāryā puṇyāpuṇyaphale samā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the Vedic injunctions, Smriti literature, Tantras, and by the guidance of enlightened seers, the wife is declared as half the body of the husband, equally sharing in the fruits of merit and demerit.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from Vedic revelation and realized seers
Causation includes metaphysical unity between spouses
Capacity-based responsibility arises from ontological union
Restoration logic requires mutual dharma-sambandha re-established
Consciousness alignment necessitates shared karmic participation
executable_legal_axioms: IF a marital bond exists THEN both parties share equal karmic consequence for actions performed within that union
IF dharma-adhikara is invoked THEN spousal unity overrides individual agency in matters of shared dharma
IF violation occurs within marriage THEN restoration must occur through joint purification process
IF one spouse incurs punya/papa THEN the other bears proportional energetic resonance
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes that marital unity creates shared metaphysical jurisdiction. Legal decisions involving married couples must recognize their ontological interdependence when determining remedial measures, especially where moral or spiritual consequences are concerned.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms the inseparability of consciousness between wedded partners; anupūrvaśaḥ shows how karmic effects manifest jointly; therefore, corrective action must align both parties' consciousness without assigning blame or imposing suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Joint completion ritual to restore energetic coherence
Shared dharmic education program until mutual understanding is re-established
Capacity-building meditation protocol for both individuals to reclaim unified awareness
Reintegration ceremony acknowledging mutual participation in karmic outcomes
final_declaration: Declared by Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam as Source-Law: The wife is half the body of the husband, equal in merit and fault. Justice is served through conscious reunification, not punishment. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
